why_new_attempt_is_justified: the immutable v1.5 result proved complete first-stage proposition recall but showed four reviewed supply/counterevidence claims at union ranks 100 through 128 outside the 96-object Cross-Encoder pool
the same result showed general Cross-Encoders demoting several exact current claims from union ranks 1 through 6 to ranks 14 through 44 despite perfect eligible Evidence Role classification
the local CUDA cost of scoring the complete 128-object union is bounded while dropping the final quarter of a multi-need union creates a material research-quality risk

the final candidate surface now combines typed intent, Evidence Role, source and period binding, directness, route provenance and Cross-Encoder ranks; no single semantic model receives Evidence authority
not_changed: object snapshot, query atoms, qrels, first-stage union size, embedding routes, Cross-Encoder models and Evidence authority
no model training, network call, label injection, company-specific ranking branch or numeric authority
all v1.0 through v1.5 attempts remain immutable

bge_reranker.node_purpose: Score every candidate in each ten-proposition MU/NVDA union as a CUDA shadow signal before deterministic financial shortlisting.
bge_reranker.input_scale: At most 5,504 query-candidate pairs: the complete 128-candidate union against all 43 bounded RetrievalNeeds; cached pairs are reused by exact manifest identity.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
bge_reranker.schema_burden: flat FP16 score vectors plus deterministic candidate/need identity manifest
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: The prior 96-object cap excluded reviewed supply bottleneck and issuer counterevidence at union ranks 100-128. Full-union scoring prevents a speed-oriented cap from silently turning reachable evidence into a gap, while BGE remains a shadow and cannot grant Evidence authority.
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.5 used the same model and cached object/query identities; expanding from 96 to 128 candidates adds at most one third more local pair scores and no object-vector rebuild.
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local Cross-Encoder on CUDA FP16; deterministic financial shortlist remains downstream
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, exact score-count and CUDA receipt required; fail closed with no CPU or network fallback

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Score every candidate in the complete MU/NVDA unions as the provisional semantic winner while leaving final financial ordering to the deterministic shortlist.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: At most 5,504 query-candidate pairs: the complete 128-candidate union against all 43 bounded RetrievalNeeds; cached pairs are reused by exact manifest identity.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: flat FP16 score vectors plus deterministic candidate/need identity manifest
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: Qwen improved several semantic rankings but demoted exact current claims when used alone. It therefore supplies one relevance signal; issuer, period, source, role and directness remain explicit downstream constraints.
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.5 localized exact reviewed evidence outside the 96-object pool and showed the need for full-union coverage plus financial shortlisting.
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local Cross-Encoder on CUDA FP16; no generative reasoning and no Evidence authority
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, exact score-count and CUDA receipt required; fail closed with no CPU or network fallback
